snippet.title: WALKABOUT MINIGOLF - HOMESTAR RUNNER - GAME UPDATE DATE - The UploadVR Showcase - Summer 2026
snippet.description: Everybody! Everybody! Welcome to the Homestar Runner Distraction Pack, aka the ultimate takeover of Walkabout Mini Golf by Strong Bad and friends, complete with designs and in-game character experiences by The Brothers Chaps! Experience the greatest turducken of unique cosmetics, never before seen mini-games, and iconic Homestar Runner locations/bits ever seen. Grab some couch, get a whiff of the rubber handle on the putters that a thousand people have touched, and get distracted!
